authoring_method: 200 manually authored Vietnamese retail queries across 20 catalog leaf categories; gold category labels selected from catalog taxonomy before running this version of the parser. Includes conversational, colloquial, typo/accentless, attribute, price, location, comparison, budget, and suitability phrasing. No LLM output or parser output was used to create labels.
evaluation_role: Development/regression set after first-run failure inspection; final scores on this set are not untouched held-out results.

Some product attributes are absent from the source snapshot and cannot be judged for suitability.
